name: sand-restage-L8-p30
note: SAND PLAINS RESTAGING SWEEP, AND ALL FIVE WERE REJECTED - kept because they are the evidence that this direction does not work. The tour control VOIDs at Sand Plains when a drifting jelly crosses the lens: one capture in fourteen reads lensMass 0.01001 and nearest geometry 1.183 m against 0.00000 and 2.077-2.235 m in the other thirteen. Lifting the eye does not widen that clearance, because the animal is seeded around the EYE and not around the seabed. REJECTED. Eye 8 m off the seabed, pitch -0.30. The horizon survives at the very top edge but the frame is four fifths pale sediment, delivered exposure 18.42 against the shipped framing's 14.07 - and a jelly cluster is still in the upper left, which is the drifter this restaging was meant to get away from.
